en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Abu Asama, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The perfume is from the Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya’qub from abu Usamah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Using perfume is of the discipline of the Messengers ‘Alayhim al-Salam.’”
